title: 5 things to know when vibe-coding a mobile app
description: Vibe-coding a mobile app is a different beast than the web, and the stuff that bites you is not the code. It is navigation that flows like a book instead of a web, mobile-only states like offline and cache, a real simulator testing strategy, and device permissions you have to wire in by hand. Pick your stack first, Expo for speed or Swift for native. I put the full guide of every pitfall I hit in my Skool. Link in bio.
